name: contract_structure
content:
{
  "parts": [
    {
      "title": "Title",
      "kind": "title",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "No substantive content; just the agreement name."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b0"]},
    {
      "title": "Parties",
      "kind": "parties",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Verify legal names and addresses; standard identification."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b1"]},
    {
      "title": "Heading 1",
      "kind": "heading",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Section heading, no review needed."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b2"]},
    {
      "title": "1.1 Purpose",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard purpose statement; confirm scope of business relationship."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b3"]},
    {
      "title": "1.2 Definition of Confidential Information",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Core definition; scope of protected information is critical."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b4"]},
    {
      "title": "1.3 Exclusions from Confidential Information",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Carve-outs determine what is not protected; important for risk assessment."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b5"]},
    {
      "title": "Heading 2",
      "kind": "heading",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Section heading, no review needed."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b6"]},
    {
      "title": "2.1 Obligations",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Core confidentiality and use restrictions; includes permitted disclosure to affiliates and advisers."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b7"]},
    {
      "title": "2.2 Standard of Care",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard confidentiality care requirement; usually acceptable."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b8"]},
    {
      "title": "2.3 Required Disclosure",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard exception for legal/regulatory disclosure; check notice obligations."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b9"]},
    {
      "title": "2.4 Residuals",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Residuals clause can significantly weaken protection; often negotiated."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b10"]},
    {
      "title": "Heading 3",
      "kind": "heading",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Section heading, no review needed."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b11"]},
    {
      "title": "3.1 Return or Destruction",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard return/destroy obligation; check retention exceptions."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b12"]},
    {
      "title": "3.2 Ownership",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard ownership statement; no license granted beyond purpose."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b13"]},
    {
      "title": "3.3 No Warranty",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard 'as is' disclaimer; note deletion marker but text remains."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b14"]},
    {
      "title": "Heading 4",
      "kind": "heading",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Section heading, no review needed."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b15"]},
    {
      "title": "4.1 Term",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Duration of confidentiality obligations; trade secret protection is perpetual."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b16"]},
    {
      "title": "Heading 5",
      "kind": "heading",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Section heading, no review needed."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b17"]},
    {
      "title": "5.1 Injunctive Relief",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard equitable remedy provision."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b18"]},
    {
      "title": "5.2 No Obligation to Enter Further Agreement",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard disclaimer of future commitments."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b19"]},
    {
      "title": "5.3 Entire Agreement",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard integration clause."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b20"]},
    {
      "title": "5.4 Assignment",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard assignment restrictions with permitted transfers."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b21"]},
    {
      "title": "5.5 Notices",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard notice provisions."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b22"]},
    {
      "title": "5.6 Third Party Rights",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Standard exclusion of third-party rights under UK Act."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b23"]},
    {
      "title": "5.7 Counterparts and Electronic Signatures",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "skip",
      "reason": "Boilerplate; no substantive risk."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b24"]},
    {
      "title": "5.8 Governing Law",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Choice of law (New York) is critical; may be contentious."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b25"]},
    {
      "title": "5.9 Jurisdiction",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Exclusive jurisdiction in New York; important for dispute resolution."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b26"]},
    {
      "title": "5.10 Non-Solicitation",
      "kind": "clause",
      "depth": "full",
      "reason": "Restrictive covenant on PortSwigger; significant business impact."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b27"]},
    {
      "title": "Signature Block",
      "kind": "signature",
      "depth": "light",
      "reason": "Verify authorised signatories and execution."
    ,"paragraph_ids": ["b28"]}
  ],
  "injection_suspected": false,
  "injection_notes": ""
}
